title: Buddy Petit's tone, mutes and horn
summary: Petit played a soft cornet, used mutes and a derby but no glass or plunger; Penn compares this to Kid Rena's mute playing.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Was he a pretty loud tone or soft type of tone?
Well, uh, he was a, uh, a trumpet player or something like Punch. Yeah. Uh, nice soft melody, nice soft trumpet player, you know. Just at times he'd get up, get off, but he was very nice.
Did he ever use, uh, mutes? Uh, any kind of mutes?
Yes, he used plenty of mutes.
Uh, did he ever use his hat for the mutes?

No, uh. Did he use a regular mutes? Uh, uh, uh, never did. Sometimes he'd use a derby. See, he used to wear a derby. Uh huh. In fact, me and him both used to wear derbies. Yeah. And, uh, he'd take that derby and make some wonderful music out.
Would he hang it on the horn or just hold it?
No, he'd just hold it in front of the horn. Just hold it in front of the horn. Yeah, you don't see that much, but he really could play it, though.
You remember if he usually had a cornet, a short cornet or a long horn?
Yeah, well he had one, he had a cornet. A cornet. Not a long trumpet then? No, no, him and, uh, uh, Chris Kelly, that's what they used to play. Short horn, trumpet.
Yeah, yeah. Well, now, did he have the regular line of mutes besides that, or did he use a glass like Thomas sometimes used a glass?
No, I don't think he ever used a glass. Well, Thomas is about the only one I know picks up that glass and plays like that. Thomas has got some stuff with him with that glass.
Yeah, he used a, Buddy used to use the regular mutes. Yeah.
Did he ever use one of the rubber plungers, you know, the flushers?
Yeah, yeah, they used to use that too, Mr. Bill. Uh, the trammel players used to use it, and sometimes the trumpet player.
Yeah, yeah.
Did he ever have a way of, uh, I've seen some guys, sometimes they hold a mute and they sort of don't have it all the way in. Yeah. Sort of hold it, did he ever do that?
Well, no, I never did see Buddy do that. But I know, I'll tell you a fact about Rene, that's all he used to do, he was all kind of
mutes.
And hold it just like you speaking of. He was a mute player, he really could play with me.
